title: Calm Tea Blend Deck
brands: Calm: kraft pouch, cream label, muted lavender wash. Settled from your swipes: Calm Line, a slow evening cup to settle down.
WellNest Teas: Three Projects, Project 1: Three New Teas; R107 refresh (Max via WellNest, Oct 17 2026 20:04 ICT), built on the mockups (Max 20:09 ICT).
format_note: Every pick: A = Our Pick (draft, confirm), B = a sensible swap from the source. From Your Swipes items are settled and not asked.
